messages:
maria.rax: Kicking off canary deploy for engine-quant-kernel v2.4.0-rc3 to 10%.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Started rollout: env=canary, service=runtime-engine, image=engine-quant:v2.4.0-rc3, traffic=10%

vikram: watching perf dashboards, I'll check mem/alloc patterns.

jen: running smoke test set A now — will post results in 10m.

deploy-bot: smoke-test: checks passed=3 failed=0 latency_p90=42ms

dan: seeing +2% token generation latency on a subset of requests, possibly kv cache miss spike. @vikram can you confirm?

vikram: confirmed, p95 increased for long-context flows. digging into kernel changes related to fused attention.

maria.rax: if this is regression, we should pin and rollback. We have a scheduled change window at 20:00 UTC if rollback needed. Thoughts?

sre-oncall: recommend pin to engine-quant:v2.3.5 for affected canaries and halt further rollout. Rolling back non-impacted partitions might be noisy.

jen: smoke test B failed on higher sequence length. snapshot logs: ```ERROR: kernel_dispatch: mismatch in block_stride at ./attn_kernel.cu:214```

dan: -> agrees with regression. Propose immediate pin to v2.3.5 for canary and notify customers. I'll prepare rollback playbook.

maria.rax: agreed. @deploy-bot, pin canary to engine-quant:v2.3.5 and stop rollout.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Action queued: pin canary image -> engine-quant:v2.3.5. Stopping rollout of engine-quant:v2.4.0-rc3.

maria.rax: filing release notes entry and postmortem ticket. Change window remains for final rollback if pin doesn't stabilize.

vikram: capturing kernel diff and profiling data, will attach to ticket. ETA 45m.

jen: notifying customers of transient perf blip in canary groups; support brief prepared.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Completed: pinned canary image to engine-quant:v2.3.5 at 1763790305 by maria.rax

maria.rax: thanks all. If metrics normalize by +1h we'll resume RC fixes and re-run tests.
